text:
Ewr Hochfürstliche Durchlaucht
überreiche ich anliegend die Beantwortung
an den p Kunckel, Geruhen Höchstdieselben solche durchzusehen
ob ſie Höchſtdero Willens Meinung gemäs iſt.
Zugleich bitte ich jemanden die beide Schreiben mundiren zu
laßen, den ich bin wie zermalmt und habe mich, da meine
gute Frau heute beigesezt wird, mit den Kindern bei
meinen Schwager retwirt.
In meinen Schreiben so ich Kunkel mit sende, werde ich
noch alles gründlich auseinander sezzen – ich muß mich
mir erst in etwas zu faßen suchen. Eine Charte von
Kopoyno Skokum und Swiątniki habe ich hier
v Triebenfeld
Breslau d 24ten April 1804
Seiner Hochfürstliche
Durchlaucht

translation.en:
To Your Most Serene Highness I herewith submit the reply to the aforesaid Kunckel; may Your Highness be pleased to look it over as to whether it accords with Your Highness's will and meaning. At the same time I beg that someone be permitted to make fair copies of the two letters, for I am as though crushed, and, since my good wife is being laid to rest today, I have withdrawn with the children to my brother-in-law's.

In my letter, which I am sending along with Kunkel's, I shall set out everything thoroughly once more — I must first seek to collect myself somewhat. A map of Kopojno, Skokum and Swiątniki I have here. v Triebenfeld

Breslau, 24th April 1804

To His Most Serene

Highness

text_english:
To Your Most Serene Highness I herewith submit the reply to the aforesaid Kunckel; may Your Highness be pleased to look it over as to whether it accords with Your Highness's will and meaning. At the same time I beg that someone be permitted to make fair copies of the two letters, for I am as though crushed, and, since my good wife is being laid to rest today, I have withdrawn with the children to my brother-in-law's.

In my letter, which I am sending along with Kunkel's, I shall set out everything thoroughly once more — I must first seek to collect myself somewhat. A map of Kopojno, Skokum and Swiątniki I have here. v Triebenfeld

Breslau, 24th April 1804

To His Most Serene

Highness
summary_en: Submits a draft reply to Kunckel for the Prince's approval, asking whether it matches his wishes, and requests that someone else be allowed to make fair copies of the two letters: Triebenfeld is crushed by grief, his wife being buried that day, and has withdrawn with the children to his brother in law's house. He promises to explain everything fully in a further letter once he has collected himself, and notes that he has a map of Kopojno, Skokum and Swiątniki.
summary_de: Vorlage eines Antwortentwurfs an Kunckel zur Prüfung, ob er dem Willen des Fürsten entspricht, verbunden mit der Bitte, die beiden Briefe von anderer Hand ins Reine schreiben zu lassen. Triebenfeld entschuldigt sich mit seinem Zustand: seine Frau wird an diesem Tag begraben, er hat sich mit den Kindern zu seinem Schwager zurückgezogen und will erst später alles ausführlich darlegen. Eine Karte von Kopojno, Skokum und Swiątniki befindet sich bei ihm.
